title: Art. 4.4.1 — ICAO Annex 17, Art. 4.4.1
theme: Screening of passengers and cabin baggage
content: Each Contracting State shall establish measures to ensure that originating passengers of commercial air transport operations and their cabin baggage are screened prior to boarding an aircraft departing from a security restricted area.
